technical-summary: RSC02 step 5 review fixes (#1069): one static input projection shared by writer and replay so a valid cache hit no longer refuses its own manifest; each owner execution gets its own power run and receipt id instead of reusing the manifest instance id; replayed helper shared-memory names are guarded by an owner lock across run directories; the admitted manifest bytes are pinned against a path swap between the digest check and the child open; every replay runs a fresh S8 calibration and evidence validity check; the model fingerprint is cached by device, inode, size and times with an O(1) accumulator so a cache-hit start no longer reads the 114 GiB model; teardown after a failed test assertion is bounded and every CTest of the component carries a 120 s timeout.
user-summary-candidate: Restarting from a stored manifest now works repeatedly, refuses stale calibration, and no longer hashes the whole model on every start.
